result.reason: The clause adopts the preferred frequency, notice, business-hours, independent-auditor, confidentiality, and cost-allocation terms, but it does not expressly prohibit direct access to Company systems. It also unnecessarily adds a reciprocal audit right over vaguely defined “reporting and traffic records,” materially expanding the original commercial arrangement. The margin comment is inaccurate because the original clause already limited the audit to records reasonably related to payment calculations.
